sentence: It was possible for him to live in a happy and healthy way after the treatment.
synonym: He was able to live well and happily
synonymNote: 两者都表示他有能力以快乐健康的方式生活，意思相同。

distractors.note: 意思相反，表示被迫悲伤生活，不能替换。

distractors.word: It was hard for him to live
distractors.note: 表示生活困难，与原句意思相反，不能替换。
表示拒绝好好生活，与原句意思完全不同，不能替换。
